☛ Track pronoun references (e.g., 'He' in Q) to maintain coherence.

☛ Re-read the full paragraph to ensure meaningful flow.

☛ The order maintains chronology (plan → arrival → ticket → ride) and cause-effect (ticket → ride experience).

Rearrangement Strategy:
☛ Identify the topic-setting sentence (here, C).
☛ Track time markers ("10 a.m.", "first ride").
☛ Note connectors ("even though") and pronouns ("we", "there").
☛ Ensure logical progression: context → arrival → problem → resolution.

It was really big, all of us were yelling and crying!
